components.name: Situation Card
components.description: Signature component: a square-cornered recognition card — index number, serif situation title, plain example — that lifts and turns blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-card-situation { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 250px; width: 300px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E4E3DC; padding: 30px 28px 26px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,40,72,0.05), 0 14px 30px -18px rgba(28,40,72,0.20); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: transform .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .28s ease, border-color .22s ease; } .ds-card-situation:hover, .ds-card-situation:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(30,50,90,0.14), 0 26px 50px -24px rgba(30,50,90,0.26); border-color: #2F6FE0; outline: none; } .ds-card-situation .ds-num { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #7C7C73; transition: color .22s; } .ds-card-situation:hover .ds-num { color: #2F6FE0; } .ds-card-situation .ds-body { margin-top: auto; } .ds-card-situation h3 { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #1A1A1A; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-card-situation p { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #5F5F58; margin: 0; } .ds-card-situation .ds-go { position: absolute; right: 22px; bottom: 22px; color: #2F6FE0; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-4px); transition: opacity .24s, transform .28s; } .ds-card-situation:hover .ds-go { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

components.name: Scoped Intake Field
components.description: The secondary 'something else' escape: an underlined single-line field with a circular arrow that fills blue on hover/focus. Never the primary entry.
components.css: .ds-intake { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; max-width: 440px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #1A1A1A; padding: 9px 2px; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-intake:focus-within, .ds-intake:hover { border-color: #2F6FE0; } .ds-intake input { flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-intake input::placeholder { color: #7C7C73; } .ds-intake input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-intake button { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: none; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #5F5F58; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s, transform .24s; } .ds-intake:hover button, .ds-intake:focus-within button { background: #2F6FE0; color: #fff; transform: translateX(2px); }

components.css: .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; } .ds-brand .ds-logo { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 15px; background: #2F6FE0; display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -7px rgba(47,111,224,0.55); } .ds-brand .ds-wm { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.08; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-brand .ds-wm small { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #1E52B0; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Statement Headline
components.description: The editorial serif statement with a single italic blue emphasis word.
components.html: Let's finish one real message you need to send — together.
components.css: .ds-headline { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(31px, 3.6vw, 46px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.018em; color: #1A1A1A; margin: 0; max-width: 13ch; } .ds-headline em { font-style: italic; color: #1E52B0; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a calm, genuinely expert colleague who sits down to help you write — never a teacher, never a slick tool. It meets an overwhelmed, low-confidence user with a confident editorial voice and a warm paper surface, and hands them their own real situation to pick from. Authority comes from restraint: a large serif statement, generous whitespace, one quiet blue, and clean square-cornered cards. Warmth does the reassurance; a single blue does the trust and action. The target feeling is calm confidence — capable and in good hands, not taught or graded.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white canvas, near-black ink, one restrained blue accent — no green.
Editorial serif (Spectral) for statements; humanist sans (Hanken Grotesk) for everything you read to act.
Square-cornered cards floating on a soft ambient shadow.
Recognition over recall: the entry is concrete situations, never a blank box.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent, and it is blue. Blue also is the positive/verified signal — so the system never needs a green 'pass' color. Green is banned: in a product whose core promise is feedback, never a grade, green reads as grading.

rules.name: The Serif-Statement / Sans-Support Rule
rules.body: Spectral appears only on statements and situation titles. Everything the user reads in order to act — sub-lines, descriptions, inputs, captions — is Hanken. Never set UI controls in the serif.

rules.name: The Flat-But-Floating Rule
rules.body: Nothing is beveled or glassy. Cards are flat rectangles that merely float; the shadow's job is separation from the paper, not decoration.

rules.name: The Sharp-Card Rule
rules.body: Situation cards are never rounded. Rounding them turns editorial into generic-SaaS.

dos: Do keep blue rare — accent, focus, and the 'verified/expert-standard' signal only.
Do set statements and situation titles in Spectral; everything functional in Hanken.
Do keep situation cards square-cornered and floating on the ambient shadow.
Do keep the four situations concrete: a real situation title + a plain 'e.g.' example.
Do keep readable text at Ink Faint (#7C7C73) or darker — never lighter.
donts: Don't introduce green or any pass/fail color coding — this product shows feedback, never a grade.
Don't make the primary entry an open/blank input; recognition cards are the entry, the scoped field is secondary.
Don't round the situation cards or add glass/bevel/gradient decoration.
Don't use 'course', 'lesson', 'learn', 'score', 'grade', 'quiz', or 'streak' anywhere in the UI.
